name: Lifting padeyes, trunnions and lift points
description: The welded lifting points by which modules, jackets and packages are lifted. Design is governed by the hook load and rigging arrangement, and every padeye is a fatigue-sensitive welded attachment.

gaps.what: Padeye design load factors, material and NDT class
gaps.why: No page read gives padeye design factors or the inspection class for the welded attachment.
gaps.next_action: Fetch the lifting standard or a padeye calculation and record load factors, material and NDT class

notes: Created 2026-11-27 in the offshore-platform component sweep (item from the platform structure taxonomy). No page read yet for this class, so the gap names the parameter and where to look; Wikipedia is cited only as secondary context.
